events.title: The Subminer is in NEXT FEST October 2026!
events.summary: Exciting News, Subminers! The Subminer is taking the plunge and is a part of Next Fest October 2026.You can try out The Subminer Demo for free at Next Fest and check out some fellow incredible upcoming games! The Subminer is a game where you pilot your submarine into an alien ocean where every dive takes you into darker and more dangerous depths. events.title: 5000 Wishlists!
